relation_name: Native 与 Web UA Android 主版本兼容
tolerance: Only evaluate when both Android majors parse successfully; a UA with no Android token remains unknown.
counterexamples: ["legitimate custom user-agent override","privacy-reduced or malformed user-agent"]

relation_name: Native 与 WebView HTTP Agent Android 主版本兼容
tolerance: Only compare parsed Android majors; provider patch versions are irrelevant.
counterexamples: ["vendor-specific HTTP agent without an Android version token"]

relation_name: Android App 宿主与桌面/脚本 Web 表面不兼容
tolerance: Linux arm and Linux x86 Android surfaces remain mobile_or_ambiguous; only explicit desktop/headless/script markers violate the relation.
counterexamples: ["legitimate desktop user-agent override for site compatibility","remote debugging or test automation"]

relation_name: WebView Provider 与运行时 Web UA Chrome 主版本兼容
tolerance: Compare only major versions; an explicit application user-agent override can legitimately break equality.
counterexamples: ["custom WebSettings user-agent","vendor WebView version reporting differences"]

relation_name: WebView 默认 UA 与运行时 Web UA 软一致
tolerance: Exact mismatch is only a soft deviation because applications may deliberately override the runtime UA.

relation_name: Android 移动 UA 与触控表面软一致
tolerance: Only applies to Android browser/WebView UA classes; zero touch is not an attack verdict.
counterexamples: ["emulator or special device without a touch surface","privacy or browser compatibility behavior"]

relation_name: FeatureApp 采集链要求 JSBridge 存在
tolerance: Only applies when collector_app is featureapp; external browsers and WebViews without a designed bridge are not applicable.
counterexamples: ["collector route that intentionally disables the bridge","external browser capture"]

relation_name: Debuggable 与 Cleartext 组合是开发安全上下文
tolerance: Expected in some development and collection builds; never becomes an attack alert by itself.

relation_name: Android Native 图形栈与 Windows Direct3D WebGL 表面不兼容
tolerance: ANGLE alone is not a violation on Android; only explicit Windows/Direct3D desktop markers contradict the Android Native graphics stack.
counterexamples: ["remote rendering that intentionally exposes a desktop GPU string","future Android WebView backend reporting changes"]

relation_name: Native 物理分辨率与 Web 逻辑尺寸乘 DPR 近似一致
tolerance: Status bars, navigation bars, orientation, safe areas and visual viewport require a grouped normal-data tolerance model.

relation_name: Native 总内存与 Web deviceMemory 粗粒度兼容
tolerance: Web deviceMemory is coarse and privacy-reduced; several GB of difference may be normal.

relation_name: 移动设备传感器矩阵完整性
tolerance: Low-end phones, tablets and special devices legitimately omit individual sensors; no fixed count is official.

relation_name: 电池死值或长期接电需要时间序列验证
tolerance: A single full-battery or stable-temperature sample is normal; repeated observations over time are required.

relation_name: App 包名、版本与安装来源符合部署策略
tolerance: Manual installation is expected in development; allowed packages and installers must be versioned by deployment environment.

relation_name: 网络传输与 VPN 仅作为动态上下文
tolerance: Normal users may use VPN, Wi-Fi or cellular networks and the state changes rapidly.

relation_name: 服务端 Play Integrity Verdict 直接完整性关系
tolerance: Only server-verified verdicts are trusted; client-provided values are not evidence.

relation_name: Play Integrity 请求绑定与防重放关系
tolerance: Nonce/request binding and server verification are mandatory.

relation_name: 硬件 Key Attestation 证书链与挑战绑定
tolerance: Device capability and attestation security level must be considered; absence alone is not an attack.

relation_name: Verified Boot 状态与弱构建线索联合关系
tolerance: Current build tags and su-binary observations remain weak until verified boot is server-verified.

relation_name: WebView 文件访问设置需要与已加载 Origin 联合判断
tolerance: Settings alone do not establish unsafe loading; the loaded scheme, host and trust decision are required.
counterexamples: ["trusted local content","content access required by application design"]

relation_name: Android WebView 与非零插件表面的兼容性
tolerance: Plugin exposure differs across Chromium versions; a nonzero count cannot be declared abnormal before cross-version normal validation.

relation_name: AVD 构建、传感器和软件渲染组合关系
tolerance: Official documents establish AVD as a virtual environment but do not define goldfish/ranchu/SwiftShader risk thresholds.
